contracts: (Exactly the current Acceptance lifecycle owner can publish acceptance-passed; all non-owner attempts are denied and the authorization set is empty for them.) AND (The validator succeeds only when every enumerated Replay, seed, matrix, review, and Quick Dev artifact is readable, structurally parsed, and has authorization_set=[]; any non-empty, missing, malformed, or omitted artifact fails.)

The dedicated assertion tests must cover the observable intent of ["python", ".agents/skills/authorization/scripts/conformance_preflight.py", "--help"] using bounded fixtures, explicit arguments and expected exit/verdict assertions. Help output, a schema document alone, or an unstarted validator cannot prove the bound acceptance. Do not invoke live backends or mutate the real repository in a negative fixture.

Help output, a schema document alone, or an unstarted validator cannot prove the bound acceptance. Do not invoke live backends or mutate the real repository in a negative fixture.

The dedicated assertion tests must cover the observable intent of ["python", ".agents/skills/authorization/tests/validators/preflight_negative.py"] using bounded fixtures, explicit arguments and expected exit/verdict assertions. Help output, a schema document alone, or an unstarted validator cannot prove the bound acceptance. Do not invoke live backends or mutate the real repository in a negative fixture.

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.

selector_intents: Invoke publication with a non-owner actor while the current Acceptance lifecycle owner is fixed; assert authorization denial and no acceptance-passed publication.
Provide a non-empty machine authorization set or owner identity mismatch in the publication artifact; assert governance validation rejects it.
Run the authorization validator against a named artifact whose structured metadata contains one authorization entry; verification fails and identifies the non-empty set.
Run the validator with a named artifact omitted, unreadable, or malformed; verification fails closed instead of treating it as authorization_set=[].
